issues.message: Caveat (2) says 'The layer-1 force R2 for this run is not in probes_final, so a same-layer gap of at least 0.04 is not shown.' probes_final does list layer 1: force r2 0.6903, control 0.5861, spread 0.0344. Against the N=64 layer-1 reference of 0.8398, the same-layer gap is 0.1495, well above 0.04. The verdict is unchanged; the gap is larger than the cross-layer 0.135. However, the stated falsifier ('if the same-layer N=128 force R2 came within 0.04 of 0.8398') can already be evaluated, and it is not met. Add a note correcting the caveat and recording the same-layer gap.

The step-12000 layer-3 force value is quoted as 0.6855 ('control plus margin'). The raw value is 0.5955 + 0.0902 = 0.6857, which also matches its_r2. The difference is 0.0002 and does not affect the gain (0.019) or the horizon check (|0.6894 − 0.6857| = 0.0037 < 0.03).

summary: I recomputed every number in f-20261015-222914-b0b7 from run-20261015-214139-70d4. Layer 3 is the best-margin force layer (0.7046 − 0.5955 = 0.1091, above max(0.1, 0.048)), and force forms persistently at step 18000. The gap to N=64 (0.135), the 12k→24k gain (0.019), the horizon check (0.0037), the normalised accel_step margin (0.2182/0.285 = 0.766) and the per-decade slope all check out, so the 'supported' verdict meets expected_if_true as written. One caveat in the confidence note is factually wrong: it says the layer-1 force R2 is missing from probes_final, but that value is present.

issues.message: The seed-22 horizon check quotes step-6000 force R2 = 0.759. That is the max-over-layers value (layer 3, 0.7589). The best-margin layer is layer 1, where step-6000 R2 is 0.7497. The pre-registration requires the same-layer value and the reference is at layer 1, so |0.7497 - 0.7799| = 0.0302 > 0.03 and seed 22 should be reported as horizon-confounded, not as passing. The 6000-to-12000 gain is also quoted from max-over-layers (+0.024); the layer-1 gain is +0.023. Neither changes the verdict, but the statement 'Only seed 22 meets the 0.04 gap' needs that qualifier.

The N=64 values (0.869 for seed 22, 0.847 for seed 23) appear nowhere in raw_evidence, and no N=64 run is listed in evidence_run_ids, so the gaps of 0.096 and 0.032 cannot be verified. The confidence note says they came from the trajectory field, which breaks the pre-registered rule that values come from probes_final. The agent's other records disagree: q-20261015-214332-e0df says the same 0.096 and 0.032 were 'read from probes_final', and q-20261014-090020-b9d1 puts seed 22's layer-1 gap at about 0.086-0.089, which implies an N=64 value of about 0.860, not 0.869. Next cycle: add the N=64 runs as evidence and quote their layer-1 probes_final values.

Seed-23 final force R2 is quoted as 0.8150, but probes_final layer 1 is 0.8149 (0.815 is the step-11000 trajectory value). The same 0.8150 is carried into exp-20261015-214332-0be7 as its horizon reference. The effect is negligible.

responses.response: Accepted. Seed 22's best-margin layer at N=128 is layer 1, and its step-6000 layer-1 trained force R2 is 0.7497. The 0.759 I quoted is the max-over-layers (layer 3) value. Against the 6000-step reference of 0.7799 (layer 1), |0.7497 - 0.7799| = 0.0302, which is above the pre-registered 0.03 tolerance, so seed 22's comparison is horizon-confounded, not passing. The layer-1 gain from step 6000 to 12000 is +0.023, not +0.024. The corrected statement is: seed 22's gap (0.096) clears the 0.04 bar but is horizon-confounded by 0.0002 over tolerance, and seed 23 (gap 0.032, horizon check passes: 0.800 vs 0.7937) sits in the inconclusive band. No seed gives a clean pass, so inconclusive stays the correct verdict and the status is unchanged.

Accepted on sourcing; the numbers themselves check out. The N=64 values exist in probes_final and should have been cited as evidence. run-20261014-074634-81be (seed 22, 12000 steps) gives layer-1 force R2 0.86858 (control 0.61997), and run-20261014-074634-b5ab (seed 23) gives layer-1 0.8467 (control 0.63224). Both are the best-margin layer, so the comparison with N=128 layer 1 is same-layer. The gaps from probes_final are 0.86858 - 0.77286 = 0.0957 (seed 22) and 0.8467 - 0.81495 = 0.0318 (seed 23). The confidence note's claim that these came from the trajectory field is wrong, and so is the caveat that seed 23 could fall below 0.02. The ~0.086-0.089 in q-20261014-090020-b9d1 came from the N=128 trajectory max-over-layers value (0.783 vs probes_final 0.7729) and is superseded. Together with issue 0, the reading is: seed 22's gap is 0.096 but horizon-confounded, and seed 23's is 0.032, in the inconclusive band. Status stays inconclusive. Future paired findings will list both arms' runs in evidence_run_ids.

summary: I recomputed f-20261015-214232-07b5 from both N=128 runs. The layer-1 force values, the margins (0.1462 and 0.1815), the accel_step layer-4 values and the normalised margins (0.790 and 0.782-0.783) all check out, and the inconclusive verdict follows the pre-registered split-seed rule. The seed-22 horizon check, however, used the max-over-layers value instead of layer 1, and on the correct value it fails by a hair. The N=64 comparison values are not in the evidence, and their provenance is inconsistent across the agent's own records. Neither problem changes the inconclusive verdict.
